limitations: Synthetic demo records are not real delivery evidence.
Hashes detect changes relative to this export; they do not prove truth, authorship or a trusted timestamp.
Named acceptance is self-attested, not verified identity or a legal signature.
AI similarity suggests records to review; it is not a delivery verdict, fraud probability or legal advice.
Sandbox transactions move no real funds.

case.title: A website handover, without the ambiguity
case.scope: Three separately payable milestones. The client reviews the supporting evidence for each milestone before authorizing its payment. Repository access and accessibility checks remain separate deliverables. No escrow or legal certification is provided.

milestones.title: Responsive landing page
milestones.criterion: Deliver a responsive landing page with desktop and mobile layouts.

milestones.title: Editable source handover
milestones.criterion: Deliver the editable source files and grant the client access to the source code repository.

milestones.title: Accessibility review
milestones.criterion: Complete an accessibility review covering keyboard navigation and image alternative text.
